findings.title: Adding `order()` as an abstract method breaks existing provider implementations
findings.body: `CryptoProvider` is a public SPI, and adding this abstract method means every third-party implementation compiled against the previous interface must be updated and recompiled; old implementations can also fail at runtime when this method is invoked. Give the method a default implementation (or otherwise preserve compatibility) so existing providers remain usable.

findings.title: JWT client credentials fail when this provider is selected
findings.body: This provider is discovered and can become the global `CryptoIntegration` provider when the authz client runs without another provider. Its `getSignature` implementation always throws, so code paths that sign JWT client assertions—for example, JWT-based client authentication—fail with `UnsupportedOperationException` instead of producing a token. Implement the crypto operations required by supported authz-client credential flows, or avoid selecting this partial provider for those flows.
